core.title: Schlage B562P Double Cylinder Deadbolt with Everest S123 Keyway

text.description_html:
Schlage B562P Double Cylinder Deadbolt with Everest S123 Keyway

This double cylinder deadbolt made by Schlage will fit standard 2-1⁄8 inches (54 mm) preparations. It has an adjustable latch to fit 2-3/8 inch or 2-3/4 inch backsets; and it will fit door thicknesses ranging from 1-3/8 inches up to 1-3/4 inches. The Schlage B562P Double Cylinder Deadbolt with Everest S123 Keyway is an ANSI Grade 2 deadbolt. Operated by a key on either side of the door, it is most commonly used on doors located near windows.

Double Cylinder Deadbolt: Deadbolt thrown or retracted on both the inside and the outside by a key. Bolt automatically deadlocks when fully thrown.

Features and Specifications of Schlage B562P Deadbolt:

  • ANSI A156.5, 2001, Grade 2 auxiliary lock.
  • Comes packaged with two keys.
  • 1" deadbolt with hardened steel core.
  • Has an anti-pick shield around the cylinder
  • Zinc bolt with spinning hardened steel pin inside.
  • Door Thickness: 1-3/8" to 1-3/4"
  • Universal deadbolt fits both 2-3/8" and 2-3/4" backsets.
  • Cylinder: Everest S123 Keyway

Sold Individually. Special Factory Order. NO RETURNS
